title: Degree Plan Change Engine
description: Prices switching majors, adding a double major, adding a minor, or dropping a double major to a minor: lost-credit cost, extra-semester tuition and living cost, and delayed-graduation opportunity cost, weighed against the salary-delta NPV over a chosen horizon, with a break-even year and a go/no-go against a cheaper minor-or-internship alternative.
data_vintage: 2026 (NCES ~5.1-yr avg time-to-degree; 12-18-credit typical lost-credit band; ~2-3% typical double-major starting-pay premium)
